\title "Loop edge 04: three alternate endings"
\tempo 120
.
// The usual Guitar Pro layout: endings 1 and 2 each close the repeat.
\ro :1 0.1 |
:1 2.1 |
\ae 1 \rc 3 :1 3.1 |
\ae 2 \rc 3 :1 5.1 |
\ae 3 :1 7.1 |
// A two-bar first ending, and a final ending without a repeat close.
\ro :1 7.1 |
\ae 1 :1 8.1 |
\ae 1 \rc 2 :1 7.1 |
\ae 2 :1 5.1 |
:1 0.1
